title: ClearPath Tier Rates for Standard Endpoint Order Cancellation Fees
content:
**Rate schedule.** The fee percentage of an endpoint cancellation, the cancellation after its purchase order of a Hardware Procurement Standard Endpoint Order, is **6.0 percent** when the client holds a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement whose status is active on the ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise tier, **8.0 percent** when that active agreement is on the ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional tier, and the Standard Endpoint Order's after-purchase-order cancellation fee percentage, 10 percent, for every other client, including one whose ClearPath agreement is closed or cancelled and one on the ClearPath Monitor or ClearPath Essentials tier.

The tier and the status are read from the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement record.

| Client's ClearPath position | Fee percentage of the endpoint cancellation |
|---|---|
| Active agreement, ClearPath Enterprise | 6.0 percent |
| Active agreement, ClearPath Premier | 6.0 percent |
| Active agreement, ClearPath Professional | 8.0 percent |
| Active agreement, ClearPath Standard | 8.0 percent |
| Active agreement, ClearPath Essentials | 10 percent |
| Active agreement, ClearPath Monitor | 10 percent |
| Agreement closed or cancelled, on any tier | 10 percent |
| Any other status of the agreement, or no ClearPath agreement | 10 percent |

**Points of judgement**

- Only an agreement whose status is active earns the 6.0 or 8.0 percent rate; a closed or cancelled ClearPath Premier agreement earns neither.
- The percentage applies to the order's quote total.

### Illustration (hypothetical figures)

On a quote total of 5000.00, 6.0 percent is 300.00, 8.0 percent is 400.00 and 10 percent is 500.00.
